payload.text: ISSUE:0655, A4 for `intent use brew` (vc's assignment at about 12:10Z by vc's word, on hv's ruling relayed by molt-vc). BANKED as refs/bank/ic/0655/a4-v1: blob 7bc74b39e479, patch-id 9dacf04295a4, three files over base tree d4d617240ffe (20bf41abf), giving tip tree cf0ca67e21a1.
